source: Assistant visual review with model-generated initial hints; not organizer ground truth or a second human annotator.
definition: Smallest visually supported rectangle covering the person, including visible limbs. Exclude furniture, bags and draped garments. Image-clipped people stop at the image boundary. Full-box targets require evidence for the outer body extrema, not visibility of every interior pixel.
uncertainty: If table/neighbor hides an unknown outer body extent, record visible extent and pose only; leave all full-box coordinates NaN. Do not synthesize a hidden foot position or use neighboring GT as the target.
selection: Frozen DINOv2 ViT-S/14 crop appearance diversity; at least 180s from previously annotated frames and 300s between selected frames on each day. Manual pose-redundancy exclusions applied afterward.
geometry_training: Use only supported full boxes, preserve native camera scale, mask uncertain visible people, and reject an image when masking would remove >3% of any supported target. Never feed the sparse geometry CSV to a full-frame detector as exhaustive annotations.
reviewed_model_hints: Existing same-day-only teacher; no opposite-day fitting in annotation proposal model.
native_coordinate_tolerance_note: Working review tolerance, not an empirically verified bound on annotation error.
